title: Putting a deck together deliberately
target: How to put a deck together in TCG Card Shop Simulator using the game own deck editor, search and card pool rather than working from memory.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Cards in your collection worth playing

steps.do: Work from the card pool rather than from what you remember owning.
steps.because: the game tracks a pool of the cards there are to build from (PlayCardPool)

steps.do: Use the search when you are after something specific.
steps.because: there is a search screen for choosing a card (PlayCardSetUIScreen_SearchCardSelection)

steps.do: Add and remove through the plus-and-minus screen rather than editing by hand.
steps.because: the deck editor has a plus-and-minus screen of its own (DeckCardPlusMinusScreen)

steps.do: Read the deck as a summary before you take it to a table.
steps.because: the game keeps a compact list of the cards in a deck (DeckCompactCardDataList)

steps.do: Remember that a card can be stock and part of a deck at the same time.
steps.because: deck data is kept apart from the cards in your shop (PlayCardDeckData)

commonMistakes: Building from memory and missing cards you already own.
Selling a card that was part of a deck.
Assuming an empty board means an empty deck.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
